bio: Run by a Korean husband and Chinese wife, Goobok Mandu is a no-frills establishment that specializes in Chinese-style dumplings. The couple prepare the dumplings from scratch based on an old family recipe passed down to them by her grandmother. The dumplings are freshly made to order each time. Try the restaurant’s signature pot stickers with their glorious wafer-thin web of crispy golden crust as well as the steamed xiao long bao....
